entries.title: A computer that runs work signs in to GitLab and GitHub Enterprise
entries.body: Settings → Integrations now offers GitLab and GitHub Enterprise under each computer that runs work, beside its GitHub row. Paste a key or read GitLab's code here, and that computer keeps its own sign-in for its clones and pushes. A project on GitLab or your company's GitHub set to run there waits for that sign-in and starts once it is in place.

picture.alt: Settings → Integrations with a computer signed in to github.example.com as mona, and chips to add GitHub Enterprise and GitLab on that computer
